issues.title: Fresh corrected P2 native runtime is blocked by protected lease
issues.detail: The corrected runner now requires P1/P2 participant slots and joins P2, but the fresh approved launcher request on port 5161 was rejected before CreateGame by the protected KeepAlive runtime on port 5153. The earlier native report is historical-invalid because it operated P1 and issued SCV attacks.
issues.nextAction: After the protected runtime owner releases PID 39308/port 5153, rerun the approved launcher on a new port and require P2 participant ownership, successful Barracks/Refinery/Marine transitions, no SCV attack, and same-window ScriptError evidence.
